title: Best Nintendo Switch Lite (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed sources from TechRadar, IGN, Soswitchedon, Mumsnet, VenomUK, and CNET, selecting products mentioned by multiple sites.
assumptions: Prices are not guaranteed and may vary by retailer.

verdict.line: Picture a student who wants a portable console for commuting. The Switch Lite offers a lighter, smaller design and a comfortable handheld experience, making it ideal for on-the-go play. Its main catch is that it cannot dock to a TV.
